title: Deterministic Infra for Non-Deterministic AI Agents - Nishant Gupta, Meta Superintelligence Labs
talk_summary: Nishant Gupta argues that autonomous agents violate cloud-infra assumptions (short-lived, deterministic, bounded failures) and that reliability must be engineered below the model layer via control planes, policy gates, tracing, and distributed-systems patterns. The core prescription: models propose, infrastructure validates and enforces, with layered safety and human exception handling.

takeaways.what_they_do: The model only generates proposals; a policy engine approves and an execution gateway enforces, so probabilistic output never directly mutates production.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The model should generate proposals, infrastructure validates them, policy engine approves them, execution gateway enforces them. The model just suggests, the platform decides.

takeaways.what_they_do: Uncontrolled retries cause exponential compute growth; they cap retries and use circuit breakers/rate limits per agent to stop runaway loops.
takeaways.evidence_quote: uncontrolled retries are one of the biggest risk in agentic systems

takeaways.what_they_do: Capture traces of planning decisions, tool calls, memory lookups, and state transitions so debugging shows the decision chain, not just final output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: understanding the chain of decisions and reasoning is often more important than the final output

takeaways.technique: Treat shared agent state as a consistency problem
takeaways.what_they_do: Multi-agent shared memory produces stale reads, conflicting updates, and context drift; they frame many multi-agent failures as consistency failures, not reasoning failures.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Many multi-agent failures are actually consistency failures masquerading as reasoning failures.

takeaways.what_they_do: Safety is layered: prompt controls, tool permissions, policy validation, human approval, audit — each catching a different failure class.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Safety cannot be a single component. It must be layered.

takeaways.what_they_do: Rather than removing humans, route only ambiguous cases to them and use their decisions as calibration signals.
